headerDisplay: Turns devices that expose an HTTP API into HomeKit accessories. Settings under *Defaults* apply to every device unless the device sets its own.

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: Sent with every request, for example X-API-Key. A header with the same name replaces the one from a wider level; Authorization replaces the one the plugin computes.

value.title: Value
value.description: A literal value, env:NAME for an environment variable, or file:/path/to/value.

manufacturer.title: Manufacturer
manufacturer.description: Shown in the accessory information of HomeKit.

serialNumber.title: Serial number
serialNumber.description: Does not change the HomeKit identity of the accessory.

setterDelay.title: Setter delay (ms)
setterDelay.description: Wait before sending a set request; only the last value is sent.

bearerToken.title: Bearer token
bearerToken.description: A literal token, env:NAME for an environment variable, or file:/path/to/token.

immediately.title: Send Basic credentials immediately
immediately.description: When off, credentials are sent only after the server answers 401.

allowUnsafeEval.title: Allow unsafe eval
allowUnsafeEval.description: Allows script mappers and JavaScript in ${...} templates, which run arbitrary code with the privileges of Homebridge.

statusFault.title: Report failed reads as Status Fault
statusFault.description: Sets the Status Fault characteristic of a service while one of its reads fails, so that the Home app shows the accessory as faulty. Only for services that have this characteristic.

id.title: Identifier
id.description: Keeps the accessory in HomeKit when the device is renamed. Defaults to the name.

service.title: Service
service.description: HomeKit service type, for example Switch, Lightbulb or TemperatureSensor.

characteristic.title: Characteristic
characteristic.description: The characteristic to read or set, for example On or Brightness.

resultOnError.title: Result on error
resultOnError.description: Used as the value when the request fails, instead of reporting an error.

bearerToken.title: Bearer token
bearerToken.description: Overrides the device token for this action. A literal token, env:NAME for an environment variable, or file:/path/to/token.

inputMax.title: Input maximum
inputMax.description: Type scale. Must differ from the minimum.

clamp.title: Limit to the input range
